sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Non-Dilutive Revenue-Based Financing for Digital Brands

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (with customary matai land law overlay; statutory commercial law at national level)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Tax Information Exchange Agreement: Samoa–New Zealand (2010)
PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus, in force 2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2008; International Companies Act 1987 (as amended by International Companies Amendment Act 2009); Companies Act 2001 (Beneficial Ownership Register amendments); Registered Agents and Trustees Licensing Ordinance 1998; APG/FATF mutual evaluation obligations

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copy of each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of origin / Samoan notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Samoa has been a Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention since 1 July 2023); Consular Legalization only for non-Hague counterpart states

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation (or provisional certificate) plus extract of directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association (English charter; certified Chinese translation optional)
UBO declaration and AML/KYC onboarding form
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each UBO, verified by the SIFA-licensed registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn source of wealth affidavit for each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in country of origin / Samoan notary public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified resolutions of subscribers approving the charter and appointments

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Sanctions List, and domestic Samoa sanctions maintained by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade. Enhanced due diligence is triggered for PEPs, including source of funds and source of wealth verification, ongoing monitoring for the life of the entity, and mandatory reporting of suspicious transactions to the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – Registrar of International Companies online name reservation and clearance portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Company names must be expressed in Latin script (English or Samoan). The registered name must terminate with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Société Anonyme', or an approved abbreviation. Chinese-language full charters are permitted as contractual instruments, but the public-register name must have a certified transliteration into English or Samoan; non-Latin characters alone are not accepted in the corporate register.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The reservation is valid for 30 days and may be extended for a further 30 days upon written request and payment of an additional reservation fee prior to expiry. Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar within 14 days of the rejection notice under Section 52 of the International Companies Act 1987; if the appeal is declined, judicial review may be sought before the Supreme Court of Samoa. The applicant may also submit a new name application without prejudice.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for International Companies. A physical registered office in Samoa and a SIFA-licensed registered agent are mandatory statutory requirements; virtual office, mail-forwarding-only, or shared mailbox addresses are insufficient to satisfy the International Companies Act 1987.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate – approximately 30% within the first three-year compliance cycle; SIFA conducts unannounced inspections of licensed registered agents and may require production of minute books, financial records, and UBO register documents on a risk-based schedule.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Registrar of International Companies fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing and certificate of incorporation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under International Companies Act 1987

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal preparation of Memorandum and Articles of Association, share structure and governance documents
UBO register establishment and AML/KYC file onboarding
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance officer of the registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: AML/CFT compliance tariff under Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, EU and domestic sanctions screening for all UBOs and directors
Notarization, apostille, and consular legalization of due diligence bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoa designated Apostille Competent Authority / notary public

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation and transliteration of Chinese-language charter and constitutional documents (optional)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), Part II - Incorporation of International Companies (ss. 5-13); International Companies Regulations 2018; Companies (Fees) Regulations 2018
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International and Foreign Companies, Companies Office, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 - Application for Incorporation of an International Company, together with the notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company; the company may declare share capital in any currency; no escrow or deposit requirement applies
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the subscribers to the Memorandum of Association be and are hereby allotted 100 ordinary shares of no par value at a subscription price of US$1.00 per share, such consideration to be credited as fully paid to the share capital account of the company. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the registered office at Level 1, SNPF Plaza, Apia, Samoa, be and is hereby adopted as the statutory registered office of the company under Section 25 of the International Companies Act 1987. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT John Smith be and is hereby appointed as the first Director, and Jane Doe as the Secretary, each to hold office until the next annual general meeting or until earlier removal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Office, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-0 (Name Reservation Application) online or in person to the Companies Office. The Registrar searches the International Companies Register for identical or confusingly similar names. Upon clearance, the name is reserved for 30 days pending formal incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is disallowed, file a fresh application with three alternative names within 5 business days; or appeal to the Registrar under Part II of the International Companies Act 1987 using Form IC-0A.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa-registered notary public or a recognized foreign notary where subscribers execute offshore
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed international company service provider to draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association. Subscribers execute the documents before a notary; the notarized instruments together with consents of the first director and secretary are prepared for filing.
required_dossiers: Notarized consent and declaration of the first director
Registered office consent from the appointed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Deficient notarizations (e.g., incorrect attestation clause) are cured by re-executing the offending document before a notary recognized in Samoa and resubmitting within 7 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International and Foreign Companies, MCIL (via registered agent portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-1 together with the notarized Memorandum and Articles, director's consent, registered office consent, and proof of payment of the US$250 government filing fee. The Registrar examines statutory compliance with the International Companies Act 1987.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Director's consent and declaration of capacity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried or struck out, the registered agent must respond with Form IC-1B within 14 days, pay the resubmission fee, and upload corrected documents; failure to respond renders the application void without prejudice to subsequent refiling.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Registry Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International and Foreign Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon verification, the Registrar enters the company in the International Companies Register, endorses the Certificate of Incorporation with the company number, and issues the certified Certificate together with a certified copy of the Memorandum and Articles.
required_dossiers: Fully executed Form IC-1 and annexed constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the issued certificate contains typographical or legal infirmities, apply for rectification under s.13 of the International Companies Act 1987 with an affidavit of the registered agent and return of the defective certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolutions, Officer Appointments, and Registered Office Adoption
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent of the International Company in Samoa and the Corporate Governance Unit of MCIL
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The subscriber-director convenes the first board meeting by circulation; adopt the registered office, ratify the share allotment and subscription, appoint the director and secretary, and approve issuance of share certificates. File officers' particulars with the Registrar within 30 days of incorporation.
required_dossiers: Share subscription schedule for the 100 ordinary shares
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late officer notification attracts late filing penalties; remedy by filing Form IC-2R with the Registrar together with a written statement of reasons under s.89 of the International Companies Act 1987; no court petition is required for non-listed international companies.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) - Business Licensing Division; no specialized industrial board applies because the entity is a non-dilutive revenue-based financing vehicle and not a manufacturing or physical production operation
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sector-specific operating or manufacturing permit is mandated; the Certificate of Incorporation is the sole operative authorization for offshore royalty financing and revenue-based financing activity

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category 4 (administrative/financial services); no EIA registration threshold is triggered as the undertaking has no physical manufacturing footprint
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable - no industrial discharge, wastewater, or VOC emission sources; office waste and confidential paper/e-waste must be handled under the Waste Management Act 2011 and applicable Basel Convention e-waste obligations

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) is required only if a physically occupied office is used; structural and load inspection by the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure (MWTI) applies to the leased premises; occupational health and safety clearance under the Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013 covers any employees. A paperless administrative or shelf international company structure remains exempt from such clearances.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue of Samoa (MfR) — official administrative portal 'E-Services / e-Revenue' at https://www.revenue.gov.ws; the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) acts as the regulatory registrar for International Companies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned International Company (IC) is statutorily exempt from Samoan income tax and requires no domestic TIN for income tax purposes. Where a TIN is nonetheless required for bank account opening, customs clearance, payroll, or VAGST compliance, the IC submits Form TIN-01 to the MfR together with the certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, passport copies of the ultimate beneficial owner, and proof of the registered office in Samoa. Processing is performed through the E-Services portal and the TIN certificate is issued digitally.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone — Samoa International Companies Act 1987 (as amended) grants a blanket income tax exemption on all IC income, regardless of the territorial source; no residence-based or remittance-based charge applies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, fiscal-transparency, or hybrid mismatch election is available under Samoan law. An IC may voluntarily convert to a domestic company under the International Companies Act 1987, thereby becoming subject to the Income Tax Act 2015; however, such conversion is effectively irreversible and commercially detrimental to a cross-border royalty-financing fund. Samoa has not enacted BEPS Action 2 hybrid mismatch or CFC election rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: ≈ WST 100,000 annual taxable turnover (VAGST Act 2009, as amended); the threshold is not engaged by an IC whose supplies are made exclusively to non-residents and that holds no Samoan business presence.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa imposes no national real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or continuous transaction control (CTC) mandate. VAGST-registered persons must issue tax invoices containing the prescribed particulars. VAGST returns and payments are submitted electronically via the MfR E-Services portal; e-invoicing integration is optional rather than compulsory.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to the physical export of goods, to specified exported services, to services supplied to a non-resident recipient for use wholly outside Samoa, and to international transport under section 7 of the VAGST Act 2009. An IC's cross-border royalty and revenue-share income from non-resident digital-brand borrowers falls outside the scope of VAGST entirely; if the IC voluntarily registers, the zero-rating rule applies where the recipient belongs outside Samoa and the service is not performed in Samoa.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (CusDec) lodged through the Samoa Customs electronic single window
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export movement
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank statement evidencing foreign currency receipt
Executed revenue-based financing agreement with the non-resident counterparty
VAGST-compliant tax invoice expressly referencing the zero-rated supply
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Samoa does not prescribe a statutory 180-day FX repatriation deadline; the 180-day metric is applied as a prudent internal compliance benchmark. Fraudulent or incorrect zero-rating claims are sanctioned under section 52 of the VAGST Act 2009 by an administrative penalty of up to 200% of the tax avoided, default interest as gazetted (currently 10% per annum), criminal fines of up to 500 penalty units, and imprisonment for up to five years. The MfR may issue retrospective reassessments within the extended audit window following false statements and claw back any input tax credits previously refunded.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), exercising powers under the Exchange Control Act 1976, the Exchange Control Regulations 1976, and the Central Bank of Samoa Act 2005, is the sole foreign-exchange and monetary authority in Samoa.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tālā (WST) is not freely convertible. Current-account payments — such as royalties, financing fees, and operational disbursements — are generally authorised when made from a licensed bank account and supported by valid contracts, invoices, and underlying economic documentation. Capital-account flows, including inbound equity subscriptions, intercompany loans, and repayment of principal, require CBS approval in certain circumstances; however, an International Company (IC) that is non-resident, has no Samoan-resident counterparties, and maintains only external foreign-currency accounts may repatriate funds without a specific CBS permit provided the transaction is not routed through a Samoan-resident WST account. Profit remittances are permissible after audited financial statements confirm distributable reserves; for a tax-exempt IC, there is no Samoan withholding tax or domestic profit tax on licensed royalty or financing-fund income generated outside Samoa.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Samoa imposes an exchange-control repatriation obligation on exporters: proceeds from exports and foreign-currency earnings must be received in Samoa through a licensed bank normally within 180 days of shipment unless a CBS exemption is granted. The mandatory conversion ratio is not applied automatically; the CBS may direct the conversion of export receipts into WST on a case-by-case basis for residents where reserve requirements necessitate. A non-resident International Company engaged exclusively in revenue-based financing for digitally originated royalty streams is not normally subject to mandatory conversion, provided no export of physical Samoan goods is involved. Any conversion or surrender variance requires a formal application through the servicing bank to the CBS Exchange Control Department using the applicable EC form or its electronic equivalent.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Multicurrency Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: LOW. Samoa does not licence standalone electronic money institutions (EMIs) under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 2005 or the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2022. A non-bank fintech cannot hold client funds or operate as a regulated clearing/EMI rail in Samoa without being a licensed commercial bank. Offshore digital EMIs may serve only as unregulated technology front-ends or ancillaries; relying on them for principal cross-border treasury clearing is legally and prudentially unsound for an International Company operating under an enhanced-medium-risk AML profile.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Licensed Samoan banks uniformly require in-person onboarding for International Companies. At least one natural-person director, preferably the authorised signatory, and every natural person with a 10% or greater beneficial interest in the IC must appear before the bank's compliance officer for a face-to-face interview in Samoa, or physically present at a designated overseas branch/correspondent bank location that allows secure video transmission of the KYC record to the CBS-compliant Samoan branch. Pure video-only remote opening without a prior financial institution relationship is not accepted; banks may refuse a file if a physical interview is not completed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusually complex ownership structure for a royalty-financing fund involving multiple cascading SPVs or nominee shareholders.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a group structure chart linking each entity to its ultimate beneficial owner; certified constitutional documents (deed of incorporation, memorandum and articles, register of members and charges); confirmatory search reports from the Samoa Registrar of International Companies; COP or apostilled passport pages; source-of-funds statements and audited financial statements for investors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Revenue-based financing cash flows from a portfolio of digital brands that have no physical contracts with the IC and rely on non-bank payment services.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver executed master financing and royalty repurchase agreements; underlying loan/drip-funding schedules; verified digital-board contracts (ManageBac, Shopify, or Stripe-style reporting); borrower KYC packs; a cash-flow waterfall model; and independent audit confirmation of the aggregate portfolio receivables.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of premium or restricted environments in the borrower portfolio and ambiguous jurisdictional routing of elevated ACH/wire settlements.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Present a jurisdiction risk matrix with negative media and sanction/screening results for each merchant; copies of payment-rail outputs (ACH settlement reports, SWIFT MT103 confirmations); evidence of beneficial-owner identity and address; a no-go policy statement excluding sanctioned/high-risk merchant categories; and an independent AML/CFT opinion letter by a Samoan-licensed attorney or compliance consultant.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Send SWIFT MT103 or MT202 messages from an investor/licensed bank directly to the IC's external foreign-currency account at BSP Samoa or ANZ Samoa, citing a clear narrative such as 'Non-resident funding under Revenue-Based Financing Facility' and the IC's unique financing-fund reference. The servicing bank will require a copy of the signed facility or subscription agreement, board resolutions authorising account opening and signatories, source-of-funds evidence for the sender, confirmation that the sender is not a Samoan resident, and a projected-volume ledger. Wires must not be structurally split to avoid exchange-control reporting thresholds, as the FX Monitoring System at the CBS will flag multiple related credits.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SWIFT MT103 for straight-settlement outbound royalty advances and periodic income distributions; for larger or documentary disbursements, use a commercial letter of credit advised through a Samoan licensed bank or a standby MT760 where seller security is required. All outbound settlement should clear from an external USD/WST account through the bank's correspondent network, not through the CBS-operated Samoa Interchange and Settlement System (SISS), unless a specific exchange-control permit has been issued for a WST resident-payable transaction.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forward contracts with a licensed Samoan commercial bank on WST/USD
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on WST/USD arranged through an international dealer
Cross-currency interest rate swap under an ISDA Master Agreement subject to CBS notification thresholds
Spot WST/USD and USD/WST conversions through the servicing bank at prevailing market rates

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Statement of Compliance) comprising registered office, registered agent, directors, members, share capital and beneficial ownership declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days following each anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late lodgement attracts an administrative penalty of WST 50 (approximately USD 18) per month or part thereof; continued default beyond six months exposes the company to formal notice and compulsory administrative strike-off under the International Companies Act 1987-88.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Levy for International Company in good standing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the anniversary of incorporation, subject to a 30-day grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A statutory late-payment penalty of up to 10% of the outstanding annual levy accrues for each month of default; persistent non-payment for six consecutive months triggers administrative strike-off, thereby terminating the company's legal existence after gazettal.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation updating the UBO register maintained by the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa (transmitted exclusively through the licensed Samoa registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted concurrently with the Annual Return, i.e., within 30 days after the incorporation anniversary; an updated confirmation is additionally required within 14 days following any transfer of shares or change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-disclosure or inaccurate filing subjects the registered agent and the company to administrative fines of up to USD 5,000 and suspension of the agent's operating licence; egregious or continued non-compliance permits the Registrar to strike off the International Company.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is mandatory for a tax-exempt International Company in Samoa solely by reference to turnover, assets, or member count. An audit becomes compulsory only where the board of directors so resolves, members holding not less than 10% of the paid-up share capital so demand, the Registrar of International Companies so directs, or the royalty financing fund's debt and securitization agreements contractually require certified financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Books and records must fairly reflect the company's transactions and financial position under the International Companies Act 1987-88. Financial statements may be prepared under IFRS, US GAAP, FRS, or another internationally recognized accounting framework; filing of accounts with the Registrar is not required for a tax-exempt International Company.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed Samoa registered agent must procure, verify, and record the identity of every beneficial owner at formation and update such information on an ongoing basis. Any transfer of shares must be entered in the register of members and reported to the registered agent within 14 days of the transfer; the agent must present the updated UBO details to the Registrar together with the annual return. Failure to maintain an accurate UBO register constitutes a strict-liability compliance default rendering the company liable to strike-off.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - USD 1,500 per annum including licensed registered agent, resident nominated director, and physical registered office
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - USD 7,500 for a certified audit engagement where contractually triggered by the royalty financing fund investors

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% for ordinary Samoa resident companies; 0% for an International Company (IC) because the IC is expressly outside the Samoan income tax net under the International Companies Act 1987.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 100% exemption: IC profits, capital gains, dividends, royalties and interest derived or paid by the IC are exempt from Samoan income tax; no stamp duty, gift duty or estate duty applies. A formal tax exemption certificate is available to evidence exempt status. Offshore income and payments routed through the IC are not subject to Samoan Goods and Services Tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Samoa income tax return is required for an International Company. Compliance is evidenced by the International Company Annual Return (Form IC-AR/Rev) under the International Companies Act 1987, filed through the Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA) online portal in lieu of a CIT return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; no quarterly CIT filing is required for an IC. The filing cycle aligns with the company's incorporation anniversary.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return must be lodged within six months after the IC's annual incorporation anniversary; late acceptance requires a SIFSA late-filing approval and penalty payment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered company name, registration number, and date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-resident-owned ICs, input the legal name exactly as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation. No Samoan tax file number is required because the IC is tax-exempt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Samoa and name of the licensed resident agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A licensed Samoan resident agent must be identified; non-resident directors cannot appoint a non-licensed person or a foreign entity as agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of principal business activity, e.g., ISIC 6499 — non-dilutive revenue-based financing and royalty/licensing fund.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose that no activity generates Samoa-source income; claim the tax exemption under the International Companies Act 1987. Do not report income, deductions, or taxable profit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Director and ultimate beneficial owner attestation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The non-resident beneficial owner must be disclosed to the resident agent for AML purposes but is not placed on the public register. Confirm that no Samoan-source revenue was received during the reporting period.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts an initial penalty of WST 100, with daily or monthly surcharges up to WST 200 additional for prolonged delay. Non-payment of the annual government fee triggers automatic strike-off, restoration penalties of WST 500, and potential imprisonment for knowing submission of a false declaration.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders. For an ordinary Samoa resident company, the statutory final dividend withholding tax rate is 15%; IC dividends are not Samoan-source and therefore carry zero Samoan withholding tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke treaty relief under any Samoan DTA, the non-resident shareholder must supply a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by its home tax authority to the IC's resident agent and submit the prescribed relief application to the Samoan Commissioner of Inland Revenue before or at payment date. Where accepted, the reduced rate is applied at source; excess withholding is refundable. Samoa's limited DTA network includes New Zealand and China; however, because the IC is tax-exempt and its distributions are outside Samoan tax, treaty reduction is irrelevant in most IC structures.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory final withholding tax for a non-resident payee on royalties and interest sourced in Samoa is 15% for royalties and 15% for interest. Under the Samoa–New Zealand and Samoa–China DTAs, beneficially-owned interest and royalties may be reduced to 10%, subject to TRC submission and absence of treaty abuse. Royalties and licensing fees paid by a foreign-owned IC to a foreign licensor are offshore royalties and outside Samoan WHT entirely.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None in Samoa as no comprehensive transfer-pricing documentation statute exists. The Income Tax Act 2015 imposes a general arm's-length principle for related-party transactions of resident companies, but the IC's zero-tax status removes any fiscal impact. A prudent internal transfer-pricing and substance file is recommended for all related-party transactions exceeding WST 500,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applies: an IC carrying on any 'Relevant Activity' under Samoa's International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2021, including finance and leasing, funding and investment, or intellectual property licensing, must demonstrate economic substance in Samoa. The IC must be directed and managed in Samoa, perform core income-generating activities in Samoa, maintain premises and full-time employees, and incur adequate expenditure proportional to the royalty-financing business. An Annual Economic Substance Return must be filed with SIFSA. Failure triggers financial penalties and mandatory information exchange with foreign tax authorities, exposing the IC to reclassification as a shell company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC to invoice royalty or financing revenue that in economic substance arises from Samoa-based digital-brand founders, back-dating agreements, mischaracterizing foreign-source income, or allocating substantial revenue to a foreign licensor without any operational substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Commissioner may disregard the sham arrangement and assess on commercial substance. Penalties include default interest, a penalty of up to 100% of the avoided tax, monetary penalty up to WST 50,000, and imprisonment up to 5 years under the Income Tax Act 2015.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors are jointly and severally liable for assessed taxes and penalties where they sign false returns or direct the sham structure. Corporate veil is pierced on proof of fraud, and directors face travel bans, asset freezes under Samoa's tax administration, and potential personal bankruptcy proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell company / Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC is fully managed from abroad, has no Samoan registered office, no resident director, no board meetings in Samoa, performs no core income-generating activities, and functions as a pure pass-through royalty collector without adequate employees or expenditure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of WST 50,000 for failure to file the Annual Economic Substance Return, continuing daily penalties of WST 1,000 per day, and striking-off of the IC. SIFSA will also exchange information with the foreign tax authority, exposing the structure to harsh recharacterization abroad.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers are personally liable for ESR penalties; the resident agent's license may be revoked, directors may be disqualified from managing Samoan entities for up to 10 years, and deliberately false ESR filings carry imprisonment up to 3 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC's revenue-based financing fund deploys capital to digital brands without identifying ultimate beneficial owners or lenders, accepts funds without source-of-wealth verification, uses nominee shareholders without a beneficial ownership declaration, or processes crypto/fiat payments without an AML-flagging procedure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Samoa Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018, penalties can reach WST 500,000 for corporate entities; wilful blindness or deliberate evasion of customer due diligence constitutes a criminal offense punishable by imprisonment up to 7 years, plus asset seizure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers and ultimate beneficial owners can be prosecuted personally; penalties include travel bans, asset forfeiture, a 10-year ban on holding directorships in Samoa, and extradition to treaty partners for money laundering or tax evasion.
